name: CACI International Inc
summary: CACI International Inc, through its subsidiaries, provides expertise and technology solutions in the United States, the United Kingdom, continental Europe, and internationally. The company offers command, control, communications, and intelligence technology and networks; software-defined signals intelligence and electronic warfare solutions; and digital solutions, such as enterprise and agency-unique applications, enterprise infrastructure, and business processes.
